app.name: NestFund
app.tagline: Personal finance, planning and expense tracking
app.disclaimer: NestFund only shows simulations and records. It is not financial advice.

common.name: Name
common.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this?

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.netIncomeHint: Salary paid in twelfths, transport allowance included
dashboard.mealCardHint: Separate from salary — never counted as available cash
dashboard.manualExpensesHint: Paid with salary money (excluding meal card)
dashboard.realAvailableHint: Income − fixed − ETF − savings − logged variable spending
dashboard.alertPlanned: This month's planned budget is negative by {amount}. Review the lines on the Budget page.
dashboard.alertReal: Logged spending already exceeds what is available by {amount}.
dashboard.netWorthHint: Banco CTT, Revolut, Trading 212, Trade Republic and cash
dashboard.canSpendHint: This month's actual available amount, after fixed costs, ETF and savings
dashboard.emptyBudgetHint: Add your salary and fixed costs to see how much you can spend.
dashboard.noInvestmentsHint: Connect Trading 212 or record the balance manually on the Portfolio page.
dashboard.noSpendingYet: No spending logged this month yet.
dashboard.apiSyncedHint: This balance is updated automatically by Trading 212.
dashboard.updateBalanceHint: Saves today's real balance. Movements you log afterwards are added from this value.

budget.title: Monthly budget
budget.templateHint: Changes apply to the current and future months. Past months are kept as history.
budget.pastMonthHint: This month is in the past: the lines below are that month's historical record.
budget.scenariosHint: Same budget, with the minimum and maximum salary of your range.
budget.leisureEnvelope: Leisure + variable vs. logged variable spending
budget.profileHint: Values used when creating new months and in the simulators.
budget.fixedNote: Fixed expenses are counted automatically. If you also log them as transactions in the same category, they are not counted twice.
budget.emptyItems: No budget lines yet. Add fixed costs, ETF, savings and leisure here.
budget.byCategoryHint: Actual spending compared with each category's monthly limit.
budget.noCategoryData: No category spending or limits yet.
budget.rangeHint: Available with a salary between {min} and {max}

tx.title: Transactions
tx.recurringHint: Upcoming occurrences are created automatically on the right date.
tx.importHint: Columns: date, type, amount, description, category, subcategory, payment_method, merchant, notes. Separator , or ; and dates YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY.
tx.mealCardNote: Meal-card payments show up in history and statistics, but never reduce salary money.
tx.transferError: For a transfer, pick a destination account different from the source.
tx.transferNote: Transfers between accounts are not counted as spending.
tx.emptyHint: Log your first purchase or expense — it takes a few seconds.
tx.exportHint: Download the filtered transactions as CSV (opens in Excel or Numbers).

categories.title: Categories
categories.kindHint: Investment and Savings are contributions and do not count as spending.

goals.title: Financial goals
goals.emptyHint: Set your emergency fund and house down payment to track progress.
goals.linkedHint: The current amount is the {account} balance and updates by itself. When several goals share an account, each one shows that account's full balance. To type the amount yourself, choose "Manual amount".

sim.title: Simulators
sim.houseHint: Monthly compound interest on a savings account with tiered rates.
sim.purchaseCostsHint: IMT transfer tax, stamp duty, deed and registration (estimate)
sim.notReached: Target not reached within the chosen horizon
sim.netNote: Interest shown is net of Portuguese income tax (IRS, {tax} withheld on gross interest). The annual bonus is added at the end of every 12th month.
sim.etfWarning: Warning: returns are not guaranteed. Markets can fall and you may lose money. This is an illustrative simulation without inflation, fees or taxes, and it is not financial advice.
sim.enterPrice: Enter the house price to see the down payment and costs you need.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.noBroker: Values are entered manually. You can connect Trading 212 in Settings › Connections.
portfolio.investedHint: For the savings account, invested means deposited capital.

history.title: History
history.houseEvolution: House down payment / reserve account over time

accounts.title: Accounts

purpose.traderepublic: Untouchable savings: reserve + house down payment
purpose.meal_card: Food only — never counted as available cash

accounts.checkInHint: Record an account's real balance on a date. Later movements are added automatically.

setup.title: Setup
setup.subtitle: Enter your real numbers. You can skip any step and come back whenever you like.
setup.balancesHint: How much is in each account today? Leave blank any you don’t want to fill in now.
setup.incomeHint: Your monthly net salary and the meal card top-up.
setup.fixedHint: Costs that repeat every month: gym, phone, subscriptions…
setup.goalsHint: How much do you want to save for the emergency fund and the house down payment?
setup.goalsAccountNote: Both goals follow the Trade Republic balance.
setup.doneHint: Log purchases as they happen. You can set your monthly ETF investment and savings on the Budget page.
setup.cardHint: {n} quick steps left: balances, income, fixed costs and goals.
setup.sampleDetected: This database still contains the sample data from the first version.
setup.resetHint: Removes transactions, balances, budgets, goals, custom categories, attachments and the Trading 212 connection. A full copy is saved to /data/backups automatically before anything is deleted. Built-in categories and preferences are kept.
setup.resetConfirm: I understand all data will be deleted
setup.resetDone: Data deleted. The app is ready for your real numbers.

settings.title: Settings
settings.noAuth: NestFund is not asking for a password. That is fine on a private network or behind Cloudflare Access; if it is reachable from the Internet, protect it (BASIC_AUTH_USER and BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD in your .env).

t212.description: Automatically updates your ETF value, invested capital and positions.
t212.disconnectConfirm: Remove the API key? Already synced history is kept.
t212.fallback: The app keeps using the last saved values.
t212.positionsWarning: The account summary synced, but positions could not be read. Check that the key has portfolio read permission.
t212.step1: In the Trading 212 app: Settings › API (Beta) › Generate API key.
t212.step2: Enable read permissions only: Account data and Portfolio. Do not enable Orders.
t212.step3: Paste the API key and API secret here.
t212.securityStorage: The key is validated and stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM); it is never shown or stored in plain text.
t212.securityReadOnly: NestFund only makes read requests (account summary and positions). It cannot place orders, buy or sell.
t212.securitySchedule: Syncs automatically every 6 hours. If it fails, the app keeps working with manual values.

errors.forbidden: The key has no read permission for this data.
errors.rate_limit: Trading 212 rate limit reached. Try again in a minute.
errors.not_found: Endpoint not found in the Trading 212 API.
errors.blocked: Request blocked: only reads are allowed.
errors.too_soon: Synced moments ago — wait a few seconds.
errors.key_unreadable: The stored key can no longer be read (did NESTFUND_SECRET change?). Paste the key again.
errors.internal: An internal error occurred while saving the sync.

t212.portfolioSynced: Trading 212 syncs automatically; the other accounts are entered manually.
t212.currencyNote: The account is in {currency}; values are shown without converting to euros.
t212.needsAction: Automatic syncs are paused until you update the key.

rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: Rules suggest a category when you log a transaction. The first active rule, from the top, wins. Nothing changes on its own.
rules.ifContains: If the description or store contains
rules.applyAfter: After saving, preview applying it to older transactions
rules.emptyHint: Without rules, NestFund still suggests categories from your history and common store names.
rules.previewIntro: Nothing has changed yet. Untick any transaction you want to leave as it is, then confirm.
rules.noMatches: No older transactions match this rule.
rules.backupNote: A backup copy of the database is saved first.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Real numbers from your own transactions and balances.
reports.noPrevious: No data in the previous period
reports.noSpendingHint: Log purchases, or change the filters above.
reports.noBudgetsHint: Set a monthly budget on a category to compare planned and real spending.
reports.mealNote: The meal card is shown separately and never reduces your salary money.
reports.contributions: Money moved to investing and savings
reports.noPortfolioHint: Record balances in Portfolio, or connect Trading 212, to see this chart.
reports.noContributionsTitle: No transfers to investing or savings in this period
reports.noContributionsHint: Log a transfer into Trading 212 or Trade Republic and it will show here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose which notices appear inside NestFund. Everything is off until you turn it on. Notices only inform you; they never tell you what to do with your money.
notifications.autosave: Changes are saved as soon as you switch them.
notifications.pushNote: These notices appear inside the app (bell icon). Push notifications to your phone are not available.

prefs.weeklyUncategorizedHint: Once a week, if some transactions have no category.
prefs.monthEndHint: In the last 3 days of the month: a reminder to look at your budget and goals.
prefs.categoryBudgetHint: When a category reaches 80% of its monthly budget, and again if it passes 100%.
prefs.negativeBudgetHint: When the month’s planned budget, or what is available after logged spending, is below zero.

notifications.weekly: {n} transactions have no category. Reviewing them keeps your reports and budget accurate.
notifications.monthEnd: The month is ending. A good moment to look at your budget and goals.
notifications.categoryNear: {category} has used {pct} of its budget ({spent} of {limit}).
notifications.negativePlanned: This month’s planned budget is negative by {amount}.
notifications.negativeReal: Logged spending is above what is available by {amount}.
notifications.offHint: Turn on the reminders and warnings you want. You choose each one.
notifications.noneHint: New notices appear here, and on the bell, when they apply.

backup.title: Backup and data
backup.nowHint: Saves a full copy of the database and a portable JSON file inside the data volume (the backups folder). Nothing is changed or deleted.
backup.volumeOnly: full copy, stays in the data volume
backup.exportHint: Download your data. Leave the dates empty for a complete export.
backup.periodHint: A period limits dated records (transactions, balance check-ins, month budgets, Trading 212 days). Categories, goals, budget lines and rules are always included.
backup.noSecrets: Exports never contain your Trading 212 API key.
backup.importHint: Restore a JSON backup, or import transactions from a CSV. You always see a preview first.
backup.previewFirst: Nothing is saved until you confirm the preview.
backup.readmeNote: How to restore a full database copy is explained in the README (Backup and restore).

importErrors.file: That file could not be read. Use a .json backup or a .csv of transactions (up to 25 MB).
importErrors.expired: That import has expired. Upload the file again.
importErrors.notJson: The file is not valid JSON.
importErrors.notBackup: This is not a NestFund backup.
importErrors.newerVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of NestFund. Update the app first.
importErrors.noHeader: The CSV needs a header row with at least the columns date and amount.
importErrors.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

backup.imported: Import done: {created} created, {updated} updated. A copy of the database was saved first.
backup.previewIntro: Nothing has been saved yet. Review what will happen.
backup.nothingToDo: Everything in this file is already in NestFund. There is nothing to import.
backup.invalidItems: {n} entries in the file are invalid and will be skipped.
backup.unknownCategories: {n} categories used by the file do not exist; those records are restored without a category.
backup.sectionCounts: {create} to create · {update} to update · {ignore} to ignore
backup.ignoredExist: {n} already exist and will be left untouched.

csvReasons.transfer: transfer needs a different destination account
csvReasons.repeated: identical to an earlier line in the file

backup.safetyNote: Confirming first saves a full copy of the database. Nothing is deleted, existing transactions are never overwritten, and importing the same file again changes nothing.

pwa.offline: Can't reach NestFund right now. You are seeing the last copy saved on this device; changes cannot be saved until it is reachable again.
pwa.updateReady: A new version of NestFund is ready.
pwa.title: App and offline use
pwa.iosHint: On iPhone: open this page in Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.whatIsStored: For offline use only the overview pages you have opened (dashboard, transactions, budget, goals, reports, history, simulators) are kept on this device, for up to 7 days. Settings, backups, notifications, the portfolio and Trading 212 data are never stored.
pwa.clearConfirm: Delete the pages saved on this device for offline use? Your data on the server is not affected.

interest.title: Interest (estimate)
interest.fromTomorrow: From tomorrow {base} earns {gross} gross / {net} net per day (a recent deposit starts earning the day after).
interest.explanation: Interest is calculated daily and credited monthly. Net amounts are after {tax} IRS. These are estimates: Trade Republic’s own figures always win.
interest.historyNote: Interest is credited once a month on the 1st. A balance you record after a credit replaces the estimate.
interest.configureHint: Changes only affect future months. Credits already booked keep the rate they were computed with.

income.title: Income this month
income.formHint: Salary and meal card depend on the days worked: enter the amounts every month. Nothing is assumed by default.
income.notDefined: This month's income is not set yet
income.notDefinedHint: Enter your net salary and meal card to see the budget.
income.mealSeparate: The meal card is separate from salary: it does not count as money available for saving or bank spending.
income.estimateHint: (normal days × daily rate) + (holiday days × daily rate × 2). Only a helper: the final amount can always be overridden by hand.
income.ratesSuggested: Daily rates suggested from an earlier month; please confirm them.
income.paidEquivalents: Paid days: {days} (each holiday worked counts as 2)
income.totalHint: Salary + extra + meal card (the card is not available for saving)

payNote.saturday: Paid early because day {day} falls on a Saturday
payNote.sunday: Paid early because day {day} falls on a Sunday
payNote.holiday: Paid early because day {day} is a holiday ({holiday})

income.compareTitle: Income and days worked by month
income.historyNote: Amounts you entered. "Expected" months are not confirmed yet; there are no automatic averages.
